purpose: Refresh the separately licensed National Museum fish collection in OBIS for the shared Manila Bay named-area screen and check whether its current record payload supplies per-record capture locality or waterbody context.

source.title: Fish Specimen Collection of National Museum, Philippines
source.provider: National Museum of the Philippines / ASEAN Centre for Biodiversity
source.priorDatasetLicenseEvidence: The reviewed official IPT and GBIF metadata for dataset version 1.38 state CC BY 4.0. The current OBIS occurrence payload returned no per-record license field; the dataset-level license does not supply missing locality or capture-origin evidence.

query.geometrySource: Existing exploratory Marine Regions MRGID 31579 named-bay polygon, CRS84; not an official boundary or a Bangwit navigation or fishing geometry.
query.geometryMethod: Query the polygon bounding rectangle, then point-in-multipolygon ray-cast against the unchanged three-component, eleven-ring polygon. No simplification or topology repair.
query.singleRecordDetailCheck: One occurrence detail endpoint was opened to check whether the fields omitted from the search payload were available on the detail record. That preserved-specimen record also returned no locality, waterBody, eventDate, or coordinate-uncertainty value; its identifier and coordinates are intentionally not repeated here.

screen.basisOfRecord: All 524 returned rows are PreservedSpecimen records.
screen.interpretation: The counts describe a bounded coordinate screen of preserved-specimen records, not 222 validated Manila Bay species. Coordinates fall inside a research-only named-bay polygon, while the current response lacks per-record locality, waterBody, full eventDate, and coordinate uncertainty. Source metadata describes collection contexts that include landing sites, markets, ports, and nearby seas, without a per-record capture-origin rule. Do not turn coordinate containment or sourceStateProvince into a Manila Bay or Cavite capture-site assertion.

imageReview.decision: No fish photo or image-rights record was returned with this occurrence refresh. No canonical image was added or changed.

decision.reason: The dataset has a documented CC BY 4.0 source license in the previously reviewed version, but this refreshed payload still does not establish capture locality or waterbody for its coordinate matches. A historical point inside an exploratory bay polygon is not enough to resolve the source's market, landing-site, port, and nearby-sea context.

nonClaims: The 507 geometry-filtered rows are not a complete Manila Bay checklist and do not prove current presence or absence.
The 230 scientific-name strings and 222 species-field values are not independently taxonomy-validated species totals.
The four rows with sourceStateProvince Cavite are not assigned to Cavite waters because the refreshed response has no per-record locality or waterBody.
No museum location, market, port, landing-site, or collection coordinate is assumed to be a capture coordinate.
The Marine Regions polygon is a research query area only and has no legal, navigation, municipal-water, or fishing-ground meaning.
nextActions: Keep this refresh linked to the existing National Museum dataset record; do not create a duplicate source or count it as a new species batch.
Prefer independently reusable records or studies with a documented capture locality, date, and record-level provenance for the shared bay and the region's rivers, lakes, estuaries, and wetlands.
Keep L1, L2, and L3 baseline reviews open until their full waterbody and candidate ledgers reconcile.
